title: Audit Log Viewer
content: Build audit log viewer. Log entries: list of actions with details. Filters: filter by user, action type, date. Search: search log entries. Actor: who performed the action. Target: what was affected. Changes: before/after values for edits. Timestamp: precise time of action. Export: download audit log. Pagination: handle large log volumes.

variants.simple: Display audit trail of system activities.
variants.detailed: Build audit log viewer. Log entries: list of actions with details. Filters: filter by user, action type, date. Search: search log entries. Actor: who performed the action. Target: what was affected. Changes: before/after values for edits. Timestamp: precise time of action. Export: download audit log. Pagination: handle large log volumes.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive audit log viewer for compliance and debugging. Log entry structure: timestamp (with timezone), actor (user or system), action type (verb), resource type and ID, changes (before/after), IP address, user agent. List display: table with key columns, expandable rows for full details. Action types: create, update, delete, read (if logged), login/logout, permission changes, settings changes. Filtering: by actor (user dropdown), by action type (checkboxes), by resource type, by date range, by IP. Search: full-text search across entries, search by resource ID. Change display: JSON diff view or formatted table showing changed fields, before values (red), after values (green). Related entries: link to related log entries (all actions on same resource). Export: CSV or JSON export, filtered or all, scheduled exports for compliance. Retention: display entries within retention period, indicate if older logs archived. Immutability: logs are read-only, cannot be edited or deleted (display only). Volume handling: pagination or virtual scroll for millions of entries, lazy loading. Aggregation: summary stats (actions per day, top actors), optional charts. Real-time: new entries appear at top (optional auto-refresh). Access control: audit log access is itself audited, restricted to admin roles. Compliance: GDPR/SOC2 friendly presentation, redact sensitive values. API access: programmatic access to audit logs. Anomaly detection: highlight unusual activity patterns. Print view: formatted print-friendly view for compliance documentation.
